entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning, deep learning, neural networks and ML algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering and dimensional reduction
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning models using SciPy and ScikitLearn
Deploying machine learning algorithms and pipelines on Apache Spark
Deep learning models and neural networks using Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow
Large language models and generative AI architectures
Natural language processing, computer vision, image and video processing, text analytics and recommender systems
Transformer models, attention mechanisms, positional encoding and masking
Transfer learning with LangChain, Hugging Face and PyTorch, and Gradio interfaces
reading.format: A professional certificate delivered as a 13 course series, available in 19 languages. Learning is through hands-on labs and projects, with practical evaluations and project work used to show skills.
reading.summary: The IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a professional certificate made up of a 13 course series offered by IBM on Coursera. It teaches machine learning, deep learning and generative AI, with work in Python and libraries such as SciPy, ScikitLearn, Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow. Learners build, train and deploy models, including large language models, through hands-on labs and projects. Finishing it produces a career credential and portfolio work that demonstrates practical AI engineering skills.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers and other technical specialists who want to become job ready as an AI engineer. It is listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
reading.prerequisites: Listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
